reason: Before the PR, unsupported Y/YYY tokens fell through to the timezone-offset fallback, so format("Y")/"YYY" returned UTC offsets like '+0000' instead of the literal 'Y'/'24Y' the test expects.
The PR makes format() preserve unsupported year tokens literally, so 'Y'->'Y' and 'YYY'->'YY'+'Y' as the test expects.
The PR only refactors percent-decoding into a shared helper with identical behavior; #getDecodedParam still decodes %20 to a space.
Refactor preserves decoding behavior; tryDecodeURIComponent decodes when '%' is present, so the path param returns a space.
Before the fix, reschedule() updated Redis via zincrby but never set @score, so the in-memory entry's #score/#at returned stale values.
The fix adds @score = at.to_f after zincrby, so the in-memory entry reflects the new reschedule time.
The PR changes only Range-header parsing; Content-Type/charset parsing is untouched, so the test reflects unchanged working behavior.
Unrelated PR (Range header) does not affect Content-Type charset parsing, which remains functional.
The PR only changes download-failure log messages; archiving/zip timestamp behavior is unaffected and presumed working.
Unrelated logging change; zip mtime preservation behavior unchanged.
The PR changes CredentialCache URI prefix matching; System.Text.Json async deserialization is unrelated and presumed working.
Unrelated credential-cache change; JSON sync/async deserialization parity unaffected.
The PR fixes FETCH FIRST on empty WITH HOLD cursors; INET containment with ANY operators is unrelated and presumed working.
Unrelated cursor fix; INET >>= ANY parsing/execution unaffected.
Before the fix, an IPv6 NO_PROXY entry like '::1' was transformed into an uninterpretable pattern that errored during URL parsing, so client construction failed.
The fix handles NO_PROXY IPv6 entries separately (all://[::1]), so the client is created without error.
Before the fix, Series.str.match raised for any regex flag other than re.IGNORECASE, so the DOTALL match call was rejected instead of honoring the option.
The PR restores support for DOTALL and other flags in str.match, so 'a\nc' matches and the call succeeds.
Before the fix, freezing a chain with a group plus more than two later tasks mis-wired recursive result parents, so the reconstructed result tree lost child results for the groups.
The fix updates prev_task/prev_res tracking in prepare_steps, preserving all group child results on reconstruction.

With '--' in the middle (after value1 value2), the first positional already collected its values before '--'; trailing-values mode sends --check to the second positional, matching expectations at both revisions.
Same as base: middle-position '--' yields cmd1=[value1,value2], cmd2=[--check] regardless of the first-argument-specific fix.
Before the fix, a late OSC11 response called nvim_set_option_value('background',…), which triggered OptionSet, so the test's expected OptionSet/ColorScheme firing holds.
The fix uses :noautocmd to set 'background', deliberately suppressing the OptionSet event; the test expects OptionSet to fire, so it now fails.
The PR only reorders an internal compile-time @derive read; required-field changeset validation is unrelated and presumed working.
Unrelated compile-time dependency change; required-field blank validation behavior unchanged.
